steps.title: Search box
steps.content: Use this box to jump to a verse or search your starred translations. You can also access it with Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac).

steps.title: Quick jump to a verse
steps.content: Type a reference such as John 3:16, Deut 23:1, or Psalm 23 then click the search icon or press Enter.

steps.title: Opened verse
steps.content: The verse you typed opens in your Bible.

steps.title: Search Scripture
steps.content: Try typing a word or phrase (for example "it is written"). Press Enter or click the search icon.

steps.title: Search results
steps.content: Results open in a Search tab in the side panel. Matches come from your starred translations, with your search words highlighted.

steps.title: Jump from a result
steps.content: Verses are sorted in Bible order. Clicking a verse opens it in your Bible.

steps.title: Filter by testament
steps.content: Toggle these filters show Old Testament matches, New Testament matches, or both.

steps.title: Search document titles
steps.content: Click here to search resource titles in your library instead of Scripture text. Click again to switch back to scriptures.
